goal: Implement necessary low kinetic moment PSD/trace diagnostics and frozen weighted population polynomial from Dossier I8.1 and V14.4. APIs fixed by structure_contract.rs. Finite population domain 1..32 states, Poisson mean lambda*h <=64 and truncation index m<=1024. No full kinetics, rate derivation or production wiring.

assumptions: Moment conditions necessary only; common energy units; supplied S symmetric and particle |v|<=1
Population inputs are positive weights and nonnegative offdiagonal weighted-coordinate G_ij transfer rates j to i; supplied diagonals zero; generator diagonal defined as minus column outflow
Frozen finite generator, 1..32 states, lambda=max outgoing sum; lambda*h<=64, m<=1024; lambda=0 exact identity
units: rho flux stress common energy density with particle velocities normalized by c
G rates inverse caller time; h matching time; positive inventory weights
conventions: Do not clip/project input moments or populations
Exact weighted-space tail-lumped Poisson polynomial, no time-varying or coherency claims
Truncation bound excludes roundoff; report this explicitly
boundary_conditions: rho=0 requires exact zero flux/stress; never divide by rho
h=0 or zero generator identity; stationary populations preserved

verification_limits: Fixed-input utility only; no full evolution or scientific admission
